shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular markers at boundaries of marked spans or plotted branches. Compare the marker at (4, 0) in the left image with the marker at 0 on the number line in the right image.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The plotted arc includes its right endpoint (4, 0). Right image: The interval at the left of 0 excludes 0.
Rationales: The selected left cue includes the indicated boundary point. The selected right cue excludes the indicated boundary point, so the two constraints differ in how they admit values.
